description: Pinned inputs for workflow_dispatch replay mode. Replace the placeholder values below with fields from a build-inputs artifact before enabling use_input_lock=true. The akmods upstream ref is intentionally not stored here; it comes from ci/defaults.json so there is one source of truth. Set zfs_version to the exact patch the run being replayed used (the build-inputs artifact records it); leaving it empty re-resolves the newest release on zfs_minor_version instead, which means the replay will not reproduce the original ZFS version once a newer patch exists. Set brew_image to the pinned brew_image_pinned ref the artifact records; leaving it empty falls back to DEFAULT_BREW_IMAGE in ci/defaults.json, which may have moved since the run being replayed.
